aluminum_can.note: Soda and beer cans accepted; empty, clean, dry
aluminum_can.quote: Soda and beer cans, soup and vegetable cans, foils

steel_can.note: Soup and vegetable cans accepted; empty, clean, dry
steel_can.quote: Soda and beer cans, soup and vegetable cans, foils

glass_bottle_jar.note: Glass bottles and jars accepted; no Pyrex or window glass
glass_bottle_jar.quote: Beer bottles, other beverage bottles, pickle jars

plastic_bottle.note: Plastic bottles and jugs accepted; no black plastic
plastic_bottle.quote: Plastic drink bottles, milk jugs, yogurt cups, tubs and lids, and shampoo bottles.

plastic_tub.note: Yogurt cups, tubs and lids accepted; no black plastic
plastic_tub.quote: Plastic drink bottles, milk jugs, yogurt cups, tubs and lids, and shampoo bottles.

plastic_bag_film.note: Plastic bags cannot be recycled; return to stores
plastic_bag_film.quote: Plastic shopping bags and black or white trash bags cannot be recycled.

cardboard_box.note: Shipping and cereal boxes accepted; flat, clean, dry
cardboard_box.quote: Shipping boxes, cereal boxes, egg cartons, paper towel and toilet paper rolls.

pizza_box_greasy.note: Page silent on pizza boxes; says cardboard clean and dry, no waxy coatings
pizza_box_greasy.quote: Make sure everything is clean and dry. No waxy coatings, please!

paper_clean.note: Office paper, newspaper, magazines accepted; clean and dry
paper_clean.quote: Office paper, newspaper, paper bags, magazines, junk mail

paper_cup.note: Page does not mention paper coffee cups

milk_carton.note: Page does not mention milk or juice cartons (milk jugs only)

foam.note: Styrofoam not accepted; ends up as trash
foam.quote: Styrofoam breaks apart into very very small pieces that can not be sorted by equipment.

aluminum_foil.note: Foil accepted; ball it up and keep clean

food_waste.note: Food waste and liquids not accepted in bin
food_waste.quote: They reduce the recyclability of other items.

battery.note: Batteries do not belong in recycling bin
battery.quote: Please do not put any rechargeable batteries in the trash or recycling.

other_trash.note: Tanglers, small items, black plastic etc. go in trash
other_trash.quote: Place your unwanted cords, ropes, hoses, clothing hangers, and other tanglers in the trash.
